_comment: Biological cell-type mapping config for Chong-Fly connectome extractor.

exclusion._comment: Cell super-classes to drop before any further processing. Matches against the 'super_class' or 'cell_class' column returned by CAVE, or the synthetic 'layer' tag in fallback mode.

optic_lobe._comment: Columnar filters and Elementary Motion Detectors in Medulla / Lobula Plate.

sensor_groups._comment: Mapping from physical sensor channels to biological LPTC / LC populations.

optic_flow._comment: FlowX (horizontal) and FlowY (vertical) optical-flow channels → Large-Field Tangential Cells (LPTC).

tof_depth._comment: ToF 8×8 (64-pixel) proximity grid → Lobula columnar LC4 (looming threat) and LPLC2 (looming escape).

motor_groups._comment: Descending Neuron (DN) populations mapped to flight actuator channels.

throttle._comment: Bilateral thrust / altitude. DNp09 = primary dorsal thrust command; DNp01 = secondary power modulation.

yaw._comment: Differential left-right activation of DNa01 / DNa02 encodes yaw torque.

pitch_roll._comment: Combined pitch and roll stabilization via ventral/dorsal descending pathways.

central_complex._comment: CX navigation core. Only included when include_central_complex == true.

synthetic_wiring._comment: Synapse weight ranges (uniform random) used by the synthetic fallback generator.
